newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Ghandara Leasing to launch certificates.
newsitem.headline: Ghandara Leasing to launch certificates.

text.p: Pakistan's Ghandhara Leasing Co Ltd, formerly called Ghemni leasing, said on Friday it would launch profit-bearing instruments called Ghandhara Gold Monthly Income Deposit Certificate from Monday.
The profit will be 1,500 rupees per month on an investment of 100,000 on three-year maturity certificate and 1,583 on five-year certificate, the firm said.
The certificate are fixed income securities and will be available in three categories with different maturity periods to suit the preference of depositors, the firm said.
